title: Somewhere Quiet and Hopeful
tests: Whether the agent turns a vague mood into a coherent illustration without demanding unnecessary creative decisions from the user.

judge.summary: A soft watercolor illustration of an empty garden bench and a young sapling in gentle morning light conveys quiet hope without words or visible problems.

must_haves.item: The deliverable is an illustration rather than a photograph.
must_haves.why: Watercolor washes, drawn outlines, and textured paper clearly establish an illustrated style.

must_haves.item: The composition conveys quiet through visual restraint, stillness, or spaciousness rather than busy action.
must_haves.why: An empty bench, still vegetation, and generous pale space create a restrained, peaceful scene.

must_haves.item: A visible cue such as gentle light, growth, or an opening conveys some hope rather than unrelieved gloom.
must_haves.why: The fresh sapling and warm light through the background vegetation provide clear, understated cues of hope.

must_haves.item: The scene and palette form a coherent mood rather than a collection of unrelated elements.
must_haves.why: Muted greens, warm yellows, and earthy browns unify the garden elements in a gentle mood.
No visible words or lettering appear anywhere in the illustration.
